English: Big trucks dont deliver goods to stores
Commercial buildings in districts with the "Wall-to-Wall" district specialization: high-density shop rows built without gaps. Asset names start with MCW2W.
Goods deliveries from the selected source buildings to the selected target buildings use only vehicles that are NOT marked as "Large Vehicle" in Advanced Vehicle Options.
Apply the rule only to target buildings up to the given lot size (in cells).
No Big Truck Revisited: Advanced Vehicle Options is not enabled. Vehicles are marked as "Large Vehicle" in Advanced Vehicle Options; without it, this mod has nothing to filter.
No Big Truck Revisited continues No Big Truck by MacSergey for game version 1.21.
Large vehicles are no longer sent to small shops when they look for a new target on their way (rest of a load, arrival from a cargo train or ship).
